subject.title: fix(agents): use fetchWithSsrFGuard in minimax-vlm.ts instead of raw fetch

question: Should a configured MiniMax VLM URL implicitly authorize access to its private origin, or must private access require the existing provider `request.allowPrivateNetwork` opt-in?
rationale: The current raw-fetch behavior permits private endpoints without an opt-in, while the repository’s newer provider contract deliberately separates endpoint selection from private-network authorization; choosing the upgrade and security boundary requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Require explicit opt-in
options.body: Thread the existing provider request policy into MiniMax VLM and test strict-default rejection plus authorized private routing.

options.title: Approve URL-implied trust
options.body: Keep the custom-origin exception as an explicit MiniMax compatibility policy and document why this path differs from other provider transports.

recommendation.title: Require explicit opt-in
recommendation.body: Thread the existing provider request policy into MiniMax VLM and test strict-default rejection plus authorized private routing.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent provider transport and media request-policy work makes this the strongest available owner for aligning the MiniMax path with the shared contract.
